record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: Drilbur (1 star) and Excadrill (2 stars) declare DRILL_RUN; both range 1, maxPP 100, no declared passive. The strategy is shared; unit differences are the star index only.
record.summary: The caster faces the cast target, deals TRUE damage (raw 15/30/60/120 by stars, AP-scaled, crit-capable by default) to that single target, then swaps into the target's cell via moveTo (no canBeMoved check; the target is displaced to the caster's old cell). If the cell directly behind the target (target's pre-move cell plus the facing vector) is on the board and holds an entity of the target's team, the caster sets that entity as its target and its PP is set to maxPP, so it can cast again immediately.

targeting.who: the cast target (single enemy); the chain check looks at the cell behind the target along the caster-to-target orientation
targeting.note: nextX/nextY are computed from the target's position BEFORE the damage and the swap. Orientation uses only the sign of dx and dy, so a non-straight line is rounded to one of eight directions. The chain condition tests entity.team === target.team, so it matches the target's team (an enemy of the caster), not allies.

geometry.shape: single target plus one cell behind it along the (sign-rounded) caster-to-target direction; caster ends on the target's former cell

effects.scaling: requested amount = raw table value; AP: damage x (1 + AP/100) (apBoost default true); if the cast crit (canCritByDefault true, chance from critChance), multiplied by 1 + (critPower - 1) x critReductionFactor, where Rocky Helmet and Black Augurite reductions do not apply to TRUE damage. Declared raw is not the applied amount.
effects.resolution: applied: handleDamage for TRUE skips the DEF / SPE_DEF division, then shields and other untraced modifiers; takenDamage (shield damage included) is what handleDamage reports; the result is ceiled and at least 1 when it lands. Protect / skydiving / magicBounce on the target blocks it entirely (magicBounce reflects only SPECIAL, so nothing is reflected for TRUE).

effects.description: moveTo(target cell, forcedDisplacement=false) swaps the caster and the target; the target ends on the caster's former cell. Runs after the damage, so a target killed by the damage is still on its cell until removed (death handling not traced).

If the cell behind the target (pre-move) is on board and its occupant is on the target's team, targetX/targetY/targetEntityId are set to it and pp = maxPP (applied value equals maxPP exactly; no stat helper such as addPP is used, so Big Eater Belt / Twist Band do not alter it).

starBehavior.note: indexed by the casting entity's stars; 3 and 4 star entries (60, 120) are not reachable from the bare factory stars of the listed units. Whether other mechanics raise stars was not examined.

record.positionalConditions: Chain refill only if the cell behind the target (target position + facing vector, computed before the swap) is on the board and occupied by an entity whose team equals the target's team. Orientation with dx == 0 and dy == 0 (caster and target on one cell) is an error path returning DOWNRIGHT, not expected in normal play.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state or modes. A chain sets pp to maxPP, so the next attack update can cast again at once; the repeated cast is gated by the normal pp >= maxPP && canCast check (not re-read here). moveTo sets the caster's cooldown to 100.
record.rawVsResolved: Requested: TRUE damage 15/30 (1/2 stars). Applied: x (1 + AP/100), crit factor if the cast crit, no DEF / SPE_DEF reduction (TRUE), blocked by protect / skydiving / magicBounce. Reported takenDamage: from handleDamage, shield damage included, minimum 1 if it lands. PP refill: exactly maxPP when the chain condition holds.
dependsOnUnverifiedGenericCombat: Final damage after handleDamage's shields, items, resurrection and field multipliers beyond the lines read
